the probability of acquiring listed firms decreases as the level of development of capital markets increases.
the acquisition of unlisted firms is more likely when the acquiring firm shareholders are less protected by law and the capital market is less developed.
the acquisition of listed vs unlisted firms is influenced by different factors in different legal and institutional environments.

the institutional and legal environment of the acquiring firms’ countries of origin affects the choice between the acquisition of unlisted or listed firms.
